title: Canonical compactification refinement data
statement: For the pro-etale module-object derived categories and boundary compactification refinements of [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data], with the module-derived lower-shriek convention [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek], the unbounded derived category size convention [def-weil-size-convention], and the localizing closure [sk-def-localizing-closure], define the canonical unbounded derived direct-image compositor $R(a\circ h)_* \xrightarrow{\sim} Ra_*\circ Rh_*$ normalized by the underived module compositor and K-injective derived-functor units. Define the canonical open restriction comparison for a boundary-preserving refinement, its invertibility facts, the resulting isomorphism $\theta_{h,K}$ obtained by restricting $Rh_*j\_!K$ and inverting the open-extension unit, and the canonical refinement map $e_{h,K}$ as the adjoint of $\theta_{h,K}^{-1}$. These are the actual constructions used by the refinement-coherence theorem and satisfy no arbitrary-choice clause.
